business_summary: HBT Financial, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Heartland Bank and Trust Company that provides financial products and services to consumers, businesses, and municipal entities in Illinois and Eastern Iowa. The company offers deposit account services, such as noninterest-bearing demand deposits, interest-bearing transaction accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, HSA, and IRA accounts. It also provides lending products, including non-owner occupied regulatory commercial real estate (CRE), construction and land development and multi-family; commercial and industrial and owner-occupied CRE; agricultural and farmland; one-to-four family residential loans; municipal, consumer, and other loans; residential mortgage origination and servicing; and traditional trust and investment services. In addition, the company offers digital banking services comprising online banking, mobile banking, digital payments, and personal financial management tools; small business and commercial checking accounts, and treasury management services; financial planning to consumers, trusts, and estates; and trustee and custodial services. Further, it provides investment management services; corporate retirement plan consulting and administration; retail brokerage services; farm management services, broker farmland sale, and crop insurance. The company was formerly known as Heartland Bancorp, Inc. and changed its name to HBT Financial, Inc. in September 2019. HBT Financial, Inc. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Bloomington, Illinois.
business_summary_ko: HBT Financial, Inc.는 일리노이주와 동부 아이오와주의 소비자, 기업, 지방자치단체에 금융 상품과 서비스를 제공하는 Heartland Bank and Trust Company의 은행 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 무이자 요구불 예금, 이자 지급 거래 계좌, 머니마켓 계좌, 저축 계좌, 예금 증서, HSA 및 IRA 계좌와 같은 예금 계좌 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 비소유자 점유 규제 상업용 부동산(CRE), 건설 및 토지 개발, 다가구 주택을 포함한 대출 상품도 제공합니다. 상업용, 산업용 및 자가 점유 CRE; 농업 및 농지; 1~4가족 주택 대출; 지방자치단체, 소비자 및 기타 대출; 주택 모기지 개시 및 서비스; 전통적인 신탁 및 투자 서비스. 또한 회사는 온라인 뱅킹, 모바일 뱅킹, 디지털 결제 및 개인 재무 관리 도구로 구성된 디지털 뱅킹 서비스를 제공합니다. 중소기업 및 상업 당좌 예금, 재무 관리 서비스; 소비자, 신탁 및 부동산에 대한 재무 계획; 수탁자 및 관리 서비스. 또한, 투자를 제공합니다
